pages.title: Undertale Sans Walking with Papyrus Through Snowdin Coloring Page
pages.description: Sans walks with Papyrus through Snowdin on this printable Undertale coloring page, smiling beside his taller brother as both lift a foot along a snowy path. Papyrus wears rounded armor and tall boots beside Sans's jacket and slippers, with footprints, fir trees, rocks, and small houses in the background.

pages.title: Undertale Sans Leaning Against a Wall in Snowdin Coloring Page
pages.description: Sans leans against a wall in Snowdin on this printable Undertale coloring page, crossing one leg in front of the other while keeping his hands in his jacket pockets. Broad wooden beams cross the stone-block wall behind him, with snow resting on the ledges and a fir tree nearby.

pages.title: Undertale Sans Holding a Ketchup Bottle at Grillby's Coloring Page
pages.description: Sans holds a ketchup bottle at Grillby's on this printable Undertale coloring page, raising the labeled squeeze bottle beside his grin while keeping one hand in his jacket pocket. A round stool and counter sit behind him, with bottles and glasses on a shelf and a flame-headed figure farther back.
